component.name: Decodium 4
component.summary: Weak-signal digital modes for radio amateurs

description.p: Decodium 4 is a complete station for amateur radio weak-signal digital modes. It descends from WSJT-X and adds a modern Qt Quick interface, decoders and modulators progressively rewritten in C++, integrated rig control, an advanced waterfall and panadapter, a live map, DX Cluster and PSK Reporter integration, and a QSO log.

ul.li: Q65, MSK144, JT65, JT9, JT4, FST4 and FST4W
native analogue SSTV, receive and transmit
manual QSOs, Auto Sequence, Auto CQ and Multi Answer Mode
rig control through Hamlib, including split operation and PTT
FT8 sensitivity features that adapt to the processing power available
support for non-standard and special-event callsigns
RTL-SDR receivers as an audio source

description.p: A transceiver with a computer audio interface, and optionally a CAT connection, is required to transmit. A valid amateur radio licence is required to transmit on the air.

screenshot.caption: Main window receiving FT8 on 20 metres

description.p: Safer transmit mode transitions, a repeatable layout reset, adaptive FT8 sensitivity and complete support for non-standard callsigns in FT8, FT4 and FT2.
